title: Exact CPU-scale IBP reduction heuristics
summary: Search for cheaper Feynman-integral IBP reduction policies across one-loop families, with every reduction checked by exact rational-polynomial certificates and costs measured in field operations.

credit.policy: Credit substantive work and independent verification in CONTRIBUTORS.md; publication authorship by explicit agreement. Documentation CC BY 4.0.

review.note: Maintainer: @Mister-Meeseeks, from 2026-10-21. Results are author-checked; independent review of the exact checker and the prescribed master bases, a pinned Kira 3 or FIRE 7 comparison, and independent replication of each new cost claim on fresh families are wanted before acceptance.

requirements.note: Python 3.11+ recommended; tested Python 3.14.6 arm64 macOS. Resource module required for measured runs.
